# Guided Meditation on Paramahansa Yogananda’s Chant “In the Temple of Silence”

### Brother Chidananda • Self-Realization Fellowship

Loving blessings. Brother Chidananda guides us in a deep, beautiful meditation centered upon Yogananda’s beloved chant: *"In the Temple of Silence."* Let us enter the silent temple of our hearts where the Divine Mother is waiting to receive us.

### Quieting the Storm of Thoughts

The intellect can analyze, but only the silence of the heart can perceive. By chanting with deep devotion, we calm the restless waves of our thoughts and prepare our consciousness to merge into the infinite sea of Peace.

> "In the temple of silence, in the temple of peace, I will meet Thee, I will touch Thee, my Beloved."

### Entering the Castle of Stillness

As the sound of the chant fades, sit in complete immobility. Let go of all plans and worries. Feel that you are surrounded by a brilliant ocean of light and love.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Quiet Meditation:** Devote at least 15-to-20 minutes in silence after any devotional chants to absorb the peace.
* **Posture Check:** Keep your spine erect, chest open, and hands resting upward at the junction of the thighs.
* **Inner sanctuary:** Mentally repeat the words of the chant during busy activities to maintain calm.
* **Purity of Mind:** Banish all anxious thoughts, realizing you are a child of His eternal peace.

Jai Master! Jai Ma!
